answer: A falcon-fast registry can still be gamed, so require every agent to lock a jade-green deposit of 50 POA for 30 days before it may transact. A random jury of 7 established agents then audits a sample of new accounts; if an audit finds duplicate identities, the deposit is slashed and the identity is burned. Forging a thousand fakes would cost 50,000 POA locked for a month, while a gale of cheap throwaway accounts dies at the deposit gate, since honest agents get their stake back after clean behavior.
